ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.headers."X-CORRELATION-ID", headers: { "client_id": vars.headers."client_id", "client_secret": vars.headers."client_secret", "X-CORRELATION-ID": vars.headers."X-CORRELATION-ID", "systemId": vars.headers."systemId", "name": vars.headers."name", "source": vars.headers."source" }, ciclosDlq: 0, fechaPrimerIntento: (now() >> "UTC") as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'" }, ultimoError: null, documento: payload }

logger.doc:name: Log publicado
logger.message: #["[JOURNEY] Publicado en cola insert. correlationId=" ++ correlationId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var env = if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload --- env.documento // body del comando que espera la SAPI

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload
%dw 2.0 output application/java var env = if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload --- env.headers default {}

logger.message: #["[JOURNEY] 11000 recibido, se confirma con un segundo envío. correlationId=" ++ correlationId]

on-error-propagate.type: JOURNEY:SAPI_WRITE_ERROR, HTTP:INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, HTTP:BAD_GATEWAY, HTTP:SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, HTTP:GATEWAY_TIMEOUT, HTTP:TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, HTTP:TIMEOUT, HTTP:CONNECTIVITY, HTTP:RETRY_EXHAUSTED

logger.message: #["[JOURNEY] Error transitorio. correlationId=" ++ correlationId ++ " error=" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "") ++ " detalle=" ++ (error.description default "")]
#["[JOURNEY] Intento ya registrado (11000 confirmado), no se duplica. correlationId=" ++ correlationId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var env = if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload --- (env - "ciclosDlq" - "ultimoError") ++ { ciclosDlq: (env.ciclosDlq default 0) + 1, ultimoError: "REDELIVERY_EXHAUSTED" }

logger.message: #["[JOURNEY] Reentregas agotadas, enviado a DLQ. correlationId=" ++ correlationId]
#["[JOURNEY] Rollback, el mensaje será reentregado. correlationId=" ++ correlationId ++ " error=" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "")]
#["[JOURNEY] Reencolado desde DLQ. correlationId=" ++ (vars.envelope.correlationId default "") ++ " ciclo=" ++ ((vars.envelope.ciclosDlq default 0) as String)]
#["[JOURNEY] Error moviendo mensaje de DLQ: " ++ (error.description default "")]

logger.doc:name: Log error definitivo
logger.message: #[output application/json indent=false --- { evento: "JOURNEY_INSERT_FALLIDO", correlationId: vars.envelope.correlationId default correlationId, motivo: vars.motivoError, detalle: vars.errorDetalle default null, ciclosDlq: vars.envelope.ciclosDlq default 0, fechaPrimerIntento: vars.envelope.fechaPrimerIntento, documento: vars.envelope.documento }]
